newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Fufa power venture to open by year end.
newsitem.headline: Fufa power venture to open by year end.

text.p: China's Fujian Fufa Co Ltd said on Wednesday that its 45 percent-owned power generator venture with U.S.-based Magnetek Inc will open for trial operations by the end of this year.

Magnetek holds the other 55 percent in the 100-million-yuan Magnetek (Fuzhou) Generator Co Ltd in Fuzhou, capital of the southeast Chinese province of Fujian, a company official told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
The venture aims to be fully operational in 1997, when it should add about 27 million yuan a year to Fufa's earnings, he said. Construction started in late 1995, he added.

Fuzhou-based Fufa, which specialises in making electric power generators, said in an interim report that it had net earnings of 9.50 million yuan in the first half of 1996, up from 8.61 million in the year-earlier period.
It reported after-tax profits of 18.99 million yuan for 1995, up from the previous year's level of 16.67 million.
